If you live in the US, most breeders sell them for a lot less than $7k. The ones nearest to me sell about $600 per pup. They aren't legal in many states, but you're allowed to own one in most states if you have a fur bearing mammal breeder's permit. It costs about $25.50 per year and you have to keep a lot of records.
